services.desc: Halibut fishing regulations have taken a turn for the better in 2021. In all years prior, while halibut fishing on all-depth days (the most productive season), it has been illegal to retain any bottomfish or lingcod if a pacific halibut was on board. This year marks the first time that you can keep any legal bottom fish and lingcod during the months of May, September, and October. Additionally, in the months of June, July, and August after retaining your limit of halibut, long leader gear can be deployed to harvest a limit of mid-water rockfish.
